Hydrometallurgy Froth floatation process: This method of concentration is based on the variable '.vet ability of i. ore and gangue particles in pine oil. This method is suitable for the concentration Of SUIphide ore like ZnS, PbS, HgS, CuFeS2 etc. The powered ore is mixed with "tvater and Pine Oil in big tank. The mixture is nüxed by passing compressed air. The gangue particles are Wetted by water and settled down at the bottom of tank. The ore particles are wetted by Pine Oil and formed on the surface of liquid as froth. The froth is collected in another vessel and dried. Thus the ore particles are concentrated by froth floatation process.

This process is applied for those metals which have less affinity with oxygen than for carbon. Examples are Fe, Zn, Sn, P b, Cd, Cu etC• This process is employed because:
